content.short: SupraOracles is a secure, decentralized oracle with quick finality across 36+ blockchains.
content.description: SupraOracles delivers faster, more accurate, and more secure off-chain data for decentralized applications across multiple chains. Its Tribes and Clans architecture, combined with parallel processing, strengthens decentralization and supports 3-5 seconds of full finality. The platform emphasizes verifiable data feeds and robust randomness (VRF/RNG) capabilities to power a range of use cases, from DeFi to gaming. Dapps can apply to the Supra Network Activate Program (SNAP) to access free oracle services, VRF/RNG, and hands-on technical assistance, helping top Web3 projects scale with reliable data and strong developer support.
